description: Minimum permissions for a single-window webview shell with no IPC surface: the frontend calls no Tauri API (no @tauri-apps/api import, no invoke()), so only the core window/webview/app/event permissions needed to open and run the window are granted. `core:default` also bundles menu/tray/image/resources permissions this app never uses (no tray icon, no native menu, no image or resource APIs) — narrowed to just what's needed. No filesystem, shell, dialog, or process capability is present: this project's Cargo.toml has no tauri-plugin-fs/shell/dialog/process dependency at all, so those permission namespaces don't exist to grant.
